parameters.query: WITH slot AS (SELECT CASE WHEN now() < ((date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Istanbul') + interval '1 day 17 hours 45 minutes') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Istanbul') THEN ((date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Istanbul') + interval '1 day 17 hours 45 minutes') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Istanbul') ELSE ((date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Istanbul') + interval '8 days 17 hours 45 minutes') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Istanbul') END AS scheduled_at), candidate AS (SELECT id FROM content_posts WHERE approval_status = 'approved' AND scheduled_at IS NULL AND image_path IS NOT NULL ORDER BY approved_at NULLS LAST, created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE content_posts AS post SET scheduled_at = slot.scheduled_at FROM slot, candidate WHERE post.id = candidate.id RETURNING post.id AS post_id, post.hook, post.approval_status, post.scheduled_at, post.image_path;
